environment.description: Go microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) in a public subnet with a public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no network ACL restrictions beyond default. Service is directly internet-facing. Environment variables include BUILD_HASH=a3f9c2e and sensitive AWS credentials in the instance profile.
